# DevCraft — Custom Software Solutions in Greece | Web Development Agency

> Combine Human Strategy with AI Efficiency to deliver bespoke, ISTQB-certified digital experiences. Your 1-month web project, delivered in just 1 week. Based in Thessaloniki, serving clients worldwide.

> Greek version: https://devcraft.gr/llms-el.txt
> Full bilingual guide: https://devcraft.gr/llms-full.txt

## About

DevCraft is a web development agency based in Thessaloniki, Greece. We specialize in custom web development using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Our team includes ISTQB-certified QA engineers who guarantee bug-free launches.

We serve clients in Greece and worldwide, with full bilingual support (English & Greek).

## Core Team

Our core team consists of field experts: a result-oriented Web developer, a certified UI/UX designer, an ISTQB-accredited tester, and a digital marketer focused on brand awareness and lead generation. We strive to deliver modern, fast, and secure products, believing that the final result is our best calling card.

### Greek / Ελληνικά

Η βασική μας ομάδα αποτελείται από ειδικούς του χώρου: έναν Web developer με προσανατολισμό στα αποτελέσματα, έναν πιστοποιημένο σχεδιαστή UI/UX, έναν διαπιστευμένο ελεγκτή ISTQB και έναν digital marketer με έμφαση στην αναγνωρισιμότητα της μάρκας και στη δημιουργία υποψήφιων πελατών. Στόχος μας είναι να παραδίδουμε σύγχρονα, γρήγορα και ασφαλή προϊόντα, πιστεύοντας ότι το τελικό αποτέλεσμα είναι η καλύτερη επαγγελματική μας κάρτα.

## What We Can Build (Solution Types)

DevCraft delivers a wide range of custom web solutions:

- **SaaS Platforms** — Subscription-based apps with user dashboards and recurring payments.
- **Booking & Scheduling Systems** — Custom workflows for appointments, rentals, or event registrations.
- **High-Conversion Landing Pages** — Fast, SEO-optimized pages designed specifically for lead generation.
- **Corporate / Representative Pages** — Professional sites for established firms.
- **Custom CRM & Internal Tools** — Tailored dashboards for businesses to manage data and teams.
- **Digital Guest Portals** — Elevate hospitality with interactive villa guides, instant service requests, and curated local experiences.
- **Specialized Booking Engines** — Simplified reservation flows for high-end rentals, from yacht charters to luxury equipment.

## Pricing & Service Plans

We offer four service plans. The MAXI plan is our most popular choice:

### MINI: The Clean Start (€600–€700)
Complete single-page website with all essential sections (Home, About, Services, Contact). 1 language (Greek). Includes technical SEO setup (sitemap, meta tags, indexing), social media integration, direct contact tools, GDPR & cookie compliance, auto-generated privacy policy & terms, and SSL certificate. Delivered in 2 working days.

### MIDI: The Corporate Standard (€1,000–€1,200)
Up to 5 pages with gallery/portfolio, direct contact tools, sitemap & robots.txt, GDPR compliance, auto-generated privacy policy & terms, Google Maps, and SSL certificate. 1 language. Up to 5 pages with gallery/portfolio, direct contact tools, sitemap & robots.txt, GDPR compliance, auto-generated privacy policy & terms, Google Maps, and SSL certificate. 1 language. Delivered in 6–7 working days.

### MAXI: The International Presence (€1,450–€1,700) ⭐ Most Popular
Up to 7 pages with 2–3 languages and language switcher. Includes lead capture form with spam protection, localized SEO, custom error & loading pages, admin dashboard for messages, GDPR compliance, Google Maps, and SSL certificate. Up to 7 pages with 2–3 languages and language switcher. Includes lead capture form with spam protection, localized SEO, custom error & loading pages, admin dashboard for messages, GDPR compliance, Google Maps, and SSL certificate. Delivered in 9–12 working days.

### ELITE: The Elite Performance (€1,950–€2,500)
Up to 10 pages + interactive tools with unlimited languages. Includes AI assistant, lead & booking form with spam protection, custom animations, automatic image optimization, SEO-optimized URLs, admin dashboard, GDPR compliance, Google Maps, ISTQB-certified QA, and SSL certificate. Up to 10 pages + interactive tools with unlimited languages. Includes AI assistant, lead & booking form with spam protection, custom animations, automatic image optimization, SEO-optimized URLs, admin dashboard, GDPR compliance, Google Maps, ISTQB-certified QA, and SSL certificate. Delivered in 14–16 working days.

*Prices do not include VAT.
*All plans require an annual hosting & security subscription of €300.
*Delivery starts after all content is received from the client.

Custom Annual Maintenance & Quality Assurance plans are available upon request.
Additional functionalities and custom add-ons can be tailored to your specific needs.
